purpose: Exact-byte inventory of public knowledge-bearing inputs used to keep human and Agent documentation aligned across the repo.

policy.scope: Public knowledge-bearing sources across inshell.art, THOUGHT, PATH, wallet, route, and read-only API boundaries.
policy.update: When a registered source changes, update its owning source or lock, run pnpm docs:generate, review the generated docs and source lock, then run pnpm docs:check.

groups.title: Public documentation sources
groups.reason: Human articles, Agent-readable content, authority maps, and machine-handoff selection.

groups.title: Home, PATH, Pulse, WILL, and shared docs runtime
groups.reason: Public copy, interaction, route, gallery, detail, pricing, and visualization behavior.

groups.title: Public routes and read-only resource contracts
groups.reason: The Agent index advertises these routes and their read-only semantics.

groups.title: Wallet boundary
groups.reason: Public docs distinguish passive wallet reads from signatures and transactions.

groups.title: Shared product runtime
groups.reason: Shared Ethereum, surface, utility, and Agent-protocol code used by public routes.

groups.title: Contract consumer runtime
groups.reason: Address, ABI, public metadata, and release-selection logic consumed by the Apps.

groups.title: PATH release
groups.owner: PATH Contract producer and inshell.art consumer
groups.reason: PATH permission, capacity, renderer, ABI, and release facts are imported from this lock and release.

groups.title: PATH deployment records
groups.reason: Network, address, and deployment facts shown by the App derive from these records.

groups.title: THOUGHT App runtime
groups.reason: Public THOUGHT creation, Agent transport, preview, provenance, rendering, and mint behavior.

groups.title: THOUGHT App specifications and records
groups.reason: Creative specification, provenance, metadata namespace, and App integration facts.

groups.title: THOUGHT Contract release
groups.owner: THOUGHT Contract producer and inshell.art consumer
groups.reason: Canonical Contract, renderer, metadata, protocol, and conformance facts.
